data.name: Godless Healing
data.description: You have mastered a specialized and complex technique to ignore pain by focusing your belief on the self rather than relying on faith. Heal yourself 1d8+(TL) hp /day. You have mastered a specialized and complex technique to ignore pain by focusing your belief on the self rather than relying on faith. /day when you have half your total hit points or fewer, you may heal yourself of an amount of damage equal to 1d8 plus your total Hit Dice as a move action. This is a supernatural ability.
